board: GY-8511 ML8511 UV analog sensor breakout module (5-pin: VIN, 3V3, GND, OUT, EN)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (slider 6 mW/cm2 prints 'V=1.72 UV=6.0mW/cm2'), and the footprint stage passed too. OUT is modelled linearly from the datasheet's 1.0 V dark and 2.2 V at 10 mW/cm2 (0.12 V per mW/cm2), and the driver drives EN high and waits 1 ms (TSU) before reading. Header order VIN, 3V3, GND, OUT, EN comes from Einstronic's GY-8511 wiring table and Fritzing diagram, and agrees with Tinytronics' pin list.
